summary: Steel Blaw-Knox fire tower near Three Runs, Cameron County PA, built 1923 and removed in 1979; the site is now a parking area in Quehanna Wild Area.

facts.status_note: Removed in 1979; the tower and its cabin no longer remain

access.note: Former site is a parking area for Quehanna Trail hikers in the Quehanna Wild Area; the approach road becomes a high-clearance 4x4 track at its east end

visit.trail_note: Parking area at the former site; hike of about half a mile to Three Runs Vista; the road passes private properties

events.note: Register and a hiking account both give 1979 as the removal year

evidence.supports: Steel Blaw-Knox tower built 1923 and removed 1979
evidence.quote: This steel Blaw-Knox tower was built in 1923 and removed in 1979.
The Three Runs Lookout Tower use to stand here, but was removed back in 1979.

evidence.supports: Trail called Three Runs Tower Trail in the Quehanna Wild Area; tower now removed
evidence.quote: It is called the Three Runs Tower Trail in the Quehanna Wild Area, as it provides access to this, now removed, fire tower.

evidence.supports: Tower and cabin no longer remain
evidence.quote: Although the fire tower and its associated cabin no longer remain

evidence.supports: Former site is a parking area; hike to Three Runs Vista about half a mile
evidence.quote: Where it stood is now a parking area for access to this part of the Quehanna Trail and the hike to the Three Runs Vista (about a half mile).
This part of the trail is an easy gravel road.
At the easternmost end, it becomes a high-clearance 4x4 trail with a mud hole and rutted muddy climb.
This part passes through a handful of private properties

evidence.supports: Road becomes a rocky dirt road past the gated Moyer Run Trail
evidence.quote: it becomes a rocky dirt road

evidence.supports: Drivers should respect the private properties the road passes through
evidence.quote: the driver should take care to respect them when passing through

evidence.supports: Quehanna covers parts of Elk and Moshannon State Forests
evidence.quote: it covers parts of Elk and Moshannon State Forests

sources.title: Three Runs Tower Site (Cameron County)
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register (FFLOS US 510)

sources.title: Quehanna Trail: Discovering the Eastern Sections of the Wild Area
Three Runs Tower Road / Chestnut Draft Road

notes_for_editor: Register (built 1923, removed 1979, 672 m) agrees with a hiking account (removed 1979) and an onX trail page (no tower or cabin remains; site is a parking area). Quehanna background is from Wikipedia. Staffing, builder and fires were not found in two searches. Do not confuse with the separate Three Runs record in Clearfield County (US 511, PA 340). A Natural Atlas listing names a Three Runs Lookout Tower, but its page gave only the title, so I did not use it.
